title: T40 browser-local settings only; never authority
x-runtime-constraints: unknown fields, invalid booleans, invalid JSON or more than 128 UTF8 bytes reset to muted defaults
do not persist principal/session/authorization identities, credentials, event/object IDs, drafts, content or a playback queue in preferences
a saved preference cannot arm sound or request desktop permission; every new document/identity requires an explicit current user gesture
account change, logout, scope loss or disabled capability disarms and clears the owned preference key; never clear unrelated browser storage
